root_cause.text: In the ntfs3 `ntfs_fill_super()` path, the UTF-16 volume label is copied into the fixed-size `sbi->volume.label` buffer with `utf16s_to_utf8s()`, but the code failed to NUL-terminate the result, so `ntfs3_label_show()` later used `%s` on a possibly unterminated string and could read past the buffer end.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description says `utf16s_to_utf8s()` “does not add a trailing NUL” and that if the label “fills the entire fixed buffer, ntfs3_label_show() can read past the end of sbi->volume.label”; the patch fixes this by adding explicit termination (`sbi->volume.label[err] = 0` and clamping the exact-full case to `sizeof(...)-1`).

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure the NTFS volume label is always properly NUL-terminated after conversion.
intent_record.what: In `ntfs_fill_super()`, the existing check `if (err < 0)` was expanded into a three-way branch: on error it still sets `sbi->volume.label[0] = 0`, on overflow/too-long output it now forces the last byte of `sbi->volume.label` to `0`, and on normal success it writes a terminating NUL at `sbi->volume.label[err]`.
intent_record.how: This change ensures the NTFS volume label buffer is always NUL-terminated after the UTF-16 to string conversion, preventing use of an unterminated label when the converted label exactly fills or exceeds the destination buffer.

grouping_result.intent: Ensure the NTFS volume label is always properly NUL-terminated after conversion.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly matches the root cause: it fixes the NTFS volume label conversion path by ensuring the copied label is NUL-terminated, which prevents the unterminated-string read in ntfs3_label_show().

candidates.rationale: This conversion writes the volume label into the fixed-size buffer, but the pre-fix code did not ensure a terminating NUL byte afterward, allowing later %s formatting to read past the end.
This is the final part of the label copy into the fixed-size buffer; before the fix, no explicit terminator was added after this operation, which is the root cause of the unterminated string.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement copies the UTF-16 volume label into the fixed-size buffer. In the pre-fix code path, it performed the conversion but did not ensure a trailing NUL byte, which led to an unterminated string later read by ntfs3_label_show().

This completes the label copy into sbi->volume.label. Before the fix, no explicit terminator was added after this operation, so the resulting buffer could remain unterminated and be over-read by %s formatting.
